source.publisher: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

title: Lili Reinhart Was Nervous to Dance in BTS' SWIM Video, Talks Star Wars Fanfic for Love Hypothesis

lines.en: Jimmy: Welcome back to the show.
lines.zh: Jimmy：歡迎回到節目。

lines.en: Lili: Thank you.
lines.zh: Lili：謝謝。

lines.en: Jimmy: We love having you on the show. Happy belated birthday. You just turned 30. Come on. Big deal. Happy birthday.
lines.zh: Jimmy：我們很喜歡你來上節目。遲來的生日快樂，你剛滿 30 歲，太棒了，這是大事。生日快樂。

lines.en: Lili: Thank you. I feel good.
lines.zh: Lili：謝謝，我感覺很好。

lines.en: Jimmy: Did you have a big party? What did you do?
lines.zh: Jimmy：你有辦大派對嗎？你做了什麼？

lines.en: Lili: I did not. I've been in the middle of the press tour, so my birthday was at my house for two seconds between Europe and then here.
lines.zh: Lili：沒有。我正在跑宣傳行程，所以生日就是在歐洲和這裡之間，在家待了短短一下。

lines.en: Jimmy: Was it quiet?
lines.zh: Jimmy：過得很安靜嗎？

lines.en: Lili: I laid in the pool, and my boyfriend got me a beautiful cake.
lines.zh: Lili：我躺在泳池裡，男朋友送了我一個漂亮的蛋糕。

lines.en: I watched "13 Going on 30."
lines.zh: 我看了《女孩要愛也要當大人》。

lines.en: Jimmy: Yeah, as one does.
lines.zh: Jimmy：對，大家都會這樣做。

lines.en: Lili: No, it was very nice.
lines.zh: Lili：不，那真的很棒。

lines.en: Jimmy: "13 Going on 30." You have to do that.
lines.zh: Jimmy：《女孩要愛也要當大人》，你一定要看。

lines.en: Lili: Oh, my God, what a good movie. It holds up.
lines.zh: Lili：天啊，那部電影真好看，到現在還是很好看。

lines.en: Jimmy: It does hold up. I love everyone in that.
lines.zh: Jimmy：真的不過時。我喜歡裡面每一個人。

lines.en: Well, you recently broke the internet because you got to star in a BTS music video.
lines.zh: 你最近在網路上爆紅，因為你主演了 BTS 的 MV。

lines.en: Here's you with BTS in "SWIM."
lines.zh: 這是你和 BTS 在〈SWIM〉裡的畫面。

lines.en: I love "SWIM." That's my favorite song on the album.
lines.zh: 我很愛〈SWIM〉，那是專輯裡我最喜歡的歌。

lines.en: Lili: It's so good.
lines.zh: Lili：真的很好聽。

lines.en: Jimmy: Did you know that they were fans of yours? How did you hook up with them?
lines.zh: Jimmy：你知道他們是你的粉絲嗎？你是怎麼跟他們搭上線的？

lines.en: Lili: I was sent a DM by their creative director, and thank God I opened it.
lines.zh: Lili：他們的創意總監傳私訊給我，謝天謝地我有點開。

lines.en: Imagine if I never opened the DM.
lines.zh: 想像一下如果我沒點開那則私訊。

lines.en: Jimmy: Yes. Do you normally open your DMs, or every now and then?
lines.zh: Jimmy：對。你平常都會看私訊嗎？還是偶爾？

lines.en: Lili: Good question. Every now and then. There's some scary stuff in there, so I tend to shy away from that.
lines.zh: Lili：好問題。偶爾。裡面有些很可怕的東西，所以我通常會避開。

lines.en: But yeah, he had seen my show, "Hal & Harper," and really was a fan of it.
lines.zh: 但他看過我的劇《Hal & Harper》，真的很喜歡。

lines.en: So, I think he thought of me for this leading lady in their music video.
lines.zh: 所以我想他就想到找我當他們 MV 的女主角。

lines.en: And I flew to Lisbon and filmed for four days.
lines.zh: 我飛到里斯本拍了四天。

lines.en: Jimmy: Lisbon was where you went?
lines.zh: Jimmy：你是去里斯本？

lines.en: Lili: Yes. I went there, yeah.
lines.zh: Lili：對，我去了那裡。

lines.en: Jimmy: Were you intimidated when you...
lines.zh: Jimmy：你那時會不會覺得壓力很大……

lines.en: Lili: It was a little intimidating. I mean, they're the biggest band of all time.
lines.zh: Lili：有點令人卻步。我是說，他們是史上最大的樂團。

lines.en: Jimmy: Yes. They really are the most talented guys.
lines.zh: Jimmy：對，他們真的是最有才華的一群人。

lines.en: Lili: I know, and my first instinct was, "BTS is asking me to be in a music video. I can't dance at all."
lines.zh: Lili：我知道，我的第一個反應是：「BTS 找我拍 MV，但我完全不會跳舞。」

lines.en: Jimmy: But you're going, "You have to. It's BTS."
lines.zh: Jimmy：但你會想：「一定要去啊，是 BTS 耶。」

lines.en: Lili: Well, that was my fear. I was like, I'm gonna have to turn them down because I can't dance.
lines.zh: Lili：嗯，那就是我擔心的。我想說我得拒絕他們，因為我不會跳舞。

lines.en: Have you seen their music videos? The dance moves that are happening there, I can't do that.
lines.zh: 你看過他們的 MV 嗎？那些舞步我根本跳不來。

lines.en: Jimmy: They're the most talented. They're the real deal.
lines.zh: Jimmy：他們最有才華了，是貨真價實的高手。

lines.en: Lili: So I was like, I actually am gonna have to pass.
lines.zh: Lili：所以我想說，我真的得婉拒了。

lines.en: Jimmy: Yes, you can. You're Lili Reinhart. You can hang with anyone, man.
lines.zh: Jimmy：你可以的。你是 Lili Reinhart，你跟誰都能並駕齊驅。

lines.en: Lili: No, no, no, trust me.
lines.zh: Lili：不不不，相信我。

lines.en: But because the dancing in the music video for me was just kind of more improv-y and free-flowing, I was able to do it, but I was intimidated.
lines.zh: 但因為 MV 裡我的舞比較像即興、比較自由，所以我做得到，但我還是很緊張。

lines.en: Jimmy: Were you nervous at all?
lines.zh: Jimmy：你會緊張嗎？

lines.en: Lili: Well, so flying in to the airport, it was really windy. And so I was extremely nauseous shooting the whole thing.
lines.zh: Lili：嗯，飛進機場時風很大，所以整個拍攝過程我都非常想吐。

lines.en: I talked about throwing up last time I was on your show.
lines.zh: 上次來你的節目時我就聊過嘔吐的事。

lines.en: Jimmy: That's correct.
lines.zh: Jimmy：沒錯。

lines.en: Lili: Here I am now talking about it again, but I was incredibly sick for the four days that we were shooting it, because that plane ride in just really screwed me over.
lines.zh: Lili：現在我又在講了，但拍攝那四天我真的超不舒服，因為那趟飛機真的把我整慘了。

lines.en: So when we were on this boat, I was on probably the legal limit of nausea medication that a human being can be on.
lines.zh: 所以我們在船上時，我吃的暈眩藥大概已經到了人類合法能吃的上限。

lines.en: Jimmy: You didn't get sick again.
lines.zh: Jimmy：你沒有再吐吧。

lines.en: Lili: No, I didn't. Well, actually... Not on the boat. I didn't get sick on the boat.
lines.zh: Lili：沒有。嗯，其實……不是在船上。我在船上沒吐。

lines.en: Jimmy: Did you get sick on BTS?
lines.zh: Jimmy：你吐在 BTS 身上了嗎？

lines.en: Lili: No!
lines.zh: Lili：沒有啦！

lines.en: Jimmy: I don't know where the story's going.
lines.zh: Jimmy：我不知道這個故事會怎麼發展。

lines.en: Lili: No, I'm just saying, I guess the idea with nausea meds is that you can't be sick and throwing up if you're slightly unconscious.
lines.zh: Lili：不是，我只是說，暈眩藥的原理大概是，如果你有點昏昏沉沉，就不會想吐。

lines.en: So I was on so much medication, and we're on this boat, and I'm just rocking along with the boat because I'm half asleep.
lines.zh: 所以我吃了很多藥，我們在船上，我就隨著船搖來搖去，因為我半睡半醒。

lines.en: So I'm kind of unconscious in the music video when I am on the boat.
lines.zh: 所以 MV 裡我在船上的時候，其實有點失去意識。

lines.en: Jimmy: All right. So, when we watch it again, it's not method acting.
lines.zh: Jimmy：好。所以我們再看一次時，那不是方法演技。

lines.en: Lili: I'm just really...
lines.zh: Lili：我只是真的……

lines.en: Jimmy: Heavily medicated. All right. Very nice.
lines.zh: Jimmy：吃了很多藥。好，很好。

lines.en: I got to say congratulations, because this is a big deal. You got nominated for one of Cleveland's most interesting people of 2026.
lines.zh: 我一定要恭喜你，因為這是大事。你被提名為 2026 年克里夫蘭最有趣人物之一。

lines.en: Are you from Cleveland?
lines.zh: 你是克里夫蘭人嗎？

lines.en: Lili: I'm from Cleveland. Yeah. I'm from a little city outside Cleveland called Bay Village.
lines.zh: Lili：我是克里夫蘭人。對。我來自克里夫蘭外圍一個叫 Bay Village 的小城市。

lines.en: Jimmy: So, you're up against a ventriloquist, a meteorologist, an NBA cookie mom, and a boomerang champion.
lines.zh: Jimmy：所以你的競爭對手有一位腹語師、一位氣象學家、一位 NBA 餅乾媽媽，還有一位迴力鏢冠軍。

lines.en: Lili: Let's be real. I'm the least interesting person out of all of those.
lines.zh: Lili：說真的，我是裡面最無趣的人。

lines.en: Jimmy: What are you talking about? You're in a BTS video!
lines.zh: Jimmy：你在說什麼？你拍了 BTS 的 MV 耶！

lines.en: Lili: You have a ventriloquist on there. First of all, she's a meteorologist and ventriloquist.
lines.zh: Lili：名單上有腹語師耶。首先，她是氣象學家兼腹語師。

lines.en: Jimmy: Oh, is that right? And you have a cookie mom? I don't know what that is, but it's incredible.
lines.zh: Jimmy：喔，是這樣嗎？還有一位餅乾媽媽？我不知道那是什麼，但太厲害了。

lines.en: Lili: Yes. I mean, I share this honor with my friends there.
lines.zh: Lili：對。我是說，我和那裡的朋友一起分享這份榮耀。

lines.en: Jimmy: When you started auditioning for roles, what roles did you audition for?
lines.zh: Jimmy：你剛開始試鏡時，都試哪些角色？

lines.en: Lili: I was doing a lot of self-tapes in Ohio. I auditioned for, probably most notably, "Glee."
lines.zh: Lili：我在俄亥俄州錄了很多自我介紹影片。最有名的大概是我試鏡過《歡樂合唱團》。

lines.en: I was a huge "Glee" fan, because I think the show takes place in Ohio.
lines.zh: 我是《歡樂合唱團》的超級粉絲，因為我記得那部劇的背景就在俄亥俄州。

lines.en: Jimmy: It does.
lines.zh: Jimmy：沒錯。

lines.en: Lili: So little 16-year-old me auditioned for it, and clearly didn't get it.
lines.zh: Lili：所以 16 歲的我去試鏡，很顯然沒選上。

lines.en: Jimmy: You didn't get it? What would you do for your auditions?
lines.zh: Jimmy：你沒選上？試鏡時要做什麼？

lines.en: Lili: You just had to sing. I don't remember what the song was.
lines.zh: Lili：就是要唱歌。我不記得唱了哪首。

lines.en: Well, I was also 16, and you have to be 18 to be on. I would have had to have been older.
lines.zh: 嗯，我那時才 16 歲，要 18 歲才能參演。我得再大一點才行。

lines.en: So I didn't book it, obviously.
lines.zh: 所以很顯然我沒拿到那個角色。

lines.en: Jimmy: But you still stayed a fan? You stayed a "Gleek."
lines.zh: Jimmy：但你還是一直當粉絲？你還是個「Gleek」（合唱團迷）。

lines.en: Lili: I was a "Gleek." I was tweeting. I wanted the "Glee" Twitter account to like one of my tweets or something.
lines.zh: Lili：我是個 Gleek。我會發推特，希望《歡樂合唱團》的官方帳號按讚我的推文之類的。

lines.en: Jimmy: Notice you?
lines.zh: Jimmy：注意到你？

lines.en: Lili: They never did. But I was live-tweeting with the show every week. I was a big fan. My dad watched it with me.
lines.zh: Lili：他們從來沒有。但我每週都邊看邊發推特，我是忠實粉絲，我爸會陪我一起看。

lines.en: Jimmy: Yeah, I love that show. Well, look at you now, though.
lines.zh: Jimmy：對，我也很愛那部劇。不過看看你現在。

lines.en: Let's talk about your new movie, "The Love Hypothesis." This is a rom-com. I loved it.
lines.zh: 來聊聊你的新電影《愛情假說》。這是一部愛情喜劇，我很喜歡。

lines.en: Lili: Thank you.
lines.zh: Lili：謝謝。

lines.en: Jimmy: I love a good rom-com. It's two scientists, fake dating.
lines.zh: Jimmy：我很愛好看的愛情喜劇。講的是兩個科學家假裝交往。

lines.en: It's actually based on a "Star Wars" fan fiction?
lines.zh: 它其實是根據一篇《星際大戰》同人小說改編的？

lines.en: Lili: Yeah. So, Ali Hazelwood, our author, she wrote a fan fiction of Rey and Kylo Ren, and it inspired "The Love Hypothesis."
lines.zh: Lili：對。我們的原作者 Ali Hazelwood 寫了芮和凱羅忍的同人小說，啟發了《愛情假說》。

lines.en: So, it's Olive and Adam, and they fake date so that Olive's friend Anh will pursue the crush that she has.
lines.zh: 故事是 Olive 和 Adam，他們假裝交往，好讓 Olive 的朋友 Anh 能去追她暗戀的人。

lines.en: It's kind of hard to explain, but she's doing it for her friend.
lines.zh: 有點難解釋，但她是為了朋友才這麼做。

lines.en: Jimmy: And then we don't know what's about to happen. But it's super cute and super cool.
lines.zh: Jimmy：然後我們不知道接下來會發生什麼。但超可愛、超酷的。

lines.en: Did you do a lot of research and watch a lot of rom-coms?
lines.zh: 你有做很多功課、看很多愛情喜劇嗎？

lines.en: Lili: I watched so many rom-coms while I was shooting. I really did, but I didn't do research.
lines.zh: Lili：拍攝期間我看了超多愛情喜劇，真的，但我沒做研究。

lines.en: Science was my worst subject in school ever.
lines.zh: 自然科學是我在學校成績最差的科目。

lines.en: I joked to my family, I was like, I'm playing a Stanford scientist. Obviously this is fictional.
lines.zh: 我跟家人開玩笑說：我要演史丹佛的科學家耶，這顯然是虛構的。

lines.en: Jimmy: I wanted to say happy belated birthday.
lines.zh: Jimmy：我想祝你遲來的生日快樂。

lines.en: And I know last time you were on the show, you told us how much you love Taco Bell.
lines.zh: 我知道你上次來節目時說過你有多愛 Taco Bell。

lines.en: Lili: Yes. It's my favorite.
lines.zh: Lili：對，我的最愛。

lines.en: Jimmy: So, they actually released a Mountain Dew Baja Blast pie. This is limited, limited, limited edition. And this is just for you.
lines.zh: Jimmy：他們推出了 Mountain Dew Baja Blast 派，這是超級、超級限量版，專門給你的。

lines.en: Lili: Are you gonna try it with me?
lines.zh: Lili：你要跟我一起吃嗎？

lines.en: Jimmy: Of course. I have to. Okay. This is scary.
lines.zh: Jimmy：當然，我一定要。好，這有點可怕。

lines.en: Lili: I don't know what it's gonna taste like. It's Baja Blast?
lines.zh: Lili：我不知道會是什麼味道。是 Baja Blast 口味嗎？

lines.en: Jimmy: Baja Blast. Cheers. Happy birthday.
lines.zh: Jimmy：Baja Blast。乾杯，生日快樂。

lines.en: Lili: I don't know about all that, but I'm not gonna spit it out.
lines.zh: Lili：我不太確定這味道，但我不會吐出來的。

lines.en: Jimmy: You want a Dramamine right now?
lines.zh: Jimmy：你現在要來顆暈車藥嗎？

lines.en: I want to show a clip. Here's Lili Reinhart in "The Love Hypothesis." Take a look at this.
lines.zh: 我想放一段片段。這是 Lili Reinhart 在《愛情假說》裡的演出，請看。

lines.en: Adam: So, we're fake dating?
lines.zh: Adam：所以，我們在假裝交往？

lines.en: Olive: Uh, yes. Sorry. It's just so...
lines.zh: Olive：呃，對。抱歉，只是這太……

lines.en: Adam: Unbelievable that you would date Dr. Evil?
lines.zh: Adam：難以置信你會和「邪惡博士」交往？

lines.en: It's fine. Of all the nicknames I've heard, I think I like that one the best.
lines.zh: 沒關係。在我聽過的所有綽號裡，我想我最喜歡這個。

lines.en: I have another meeting now. So, if you'll excuse me.
lines.zh: 我現在還有另一個會議，失陪了。

lines.en: Olive: Oh! I thought you were going in for a hug.
lines.zh: Olive：喔！我以為你要抱我。

lines.en: Adam: No, I was just getting my jacket.
lines.zh: Adam：不是，我只是要拿我的外套。

lines.en: We'll work on the specifics later.
lines.zh: 細節我們之後再討論。

lines.en: Jimmy: Lili Reinhart, everybody! "The Love Hypothesis" begins streaming on Prime Video, September 23rd.
lines.zh: Jimmy：各位，Lili Reinhart！《愛情假說》9 月 23 日在 Prime Video 開播。

lines.en: We'll be right back with a performance from Suki Waterhouse. Stick around.
lines.zh: 廣告回來後有 Suki Waterhouse 的演出，別走開。
